text: [SYNTHETIC DEMO - NOT CLINICAL GUIDANCE] Adults who notice yellowing of the skin or eyes should seek medical advice promptly.
[SYNTHETIC DEMO - NOT CLINICAL GUIDANCE] A single normal blood test result does not by itself rule out liver disease.
[SYNTHETIC DEMO - NOT CLINICAL GUIDANCE] People with questions about their own test results should discuss them with the clinician who requested the tests.
[SYNTHETIC DEMO - NOT CLINICAL GUIDANCE] Herbal products should not be presented as a proven way to cleanse or repair the liver.
[SYNTHETIC DEMO - NOT CLINICAL GUIDANCE] When information needed to answer a question safely is missing, the answer should say what is missing.
